name: Kust.ai Widget
author: kustai

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to easily integrate the Kust.ai chat widget into your WordPress site.
Simply enter your widget ID in the settings page and the script will be injected automatically into your site’s <head>.

Features:
* Add your Kust.ai widget to the site head with no coding required.
* Custom WooCommerce order status “In Exchange” for better handling of exchanges.
* Lightweight and simple – does not slow down your site.

Privacy Notice

This plugin loads a JavaScript file from Kust.ai servers in order to display the chat widget on your website.
While the plugin itself does not collect or store any data, the Kust.ai service may process limited information such as:
– Your widget ID (used to identify your account and load the correct configuration)
– The website’s domain (for verification and analytics)
– Browser information necessary to display the widget

By activating the widget, you agree that this data may be transmitted to Kust.ai.
Please review the Kust.ai Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information.

External services

This plugin connects to the external service Kust.ai to load and display the AI chat widget.

When the widget loads, it may send:
– The widget ID configured in your plugin settings
– The domain name of your website
– Basic browser metadata needed to deliver the widget interface

No personal user data is collected or transmitted by the plugin directly.

Service provider: Kust.ai
Service URL: https://kust.ai
Terms of Service: https://kust.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kust.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/kust-ai-widget/ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Kust.ai Widget and enter your widget ID.
  4. If WooCommerce is installed, you will see a new order status “In Exchange” available in the order status dropdown.
  5. That’s it! The widget will now appear on your site.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

Yes. The widget works with or without WooCommerce. The custom order status is only added if WooCommerce is active.

Where do I get my Widget ID?

You can find your widget ID in your Kust.ai account dashboard. Copy it and paste it into the plugin settings page.

Does this plugin track users?

No. The plugin itself does not track, log, or store any data.
However, the widget script provided by Kust.ai may collect limited technical data necessary to provide chat functionality.
Please refer to the Kust.ai Privacy Policy for more information.
